## What Are Templates?

Templates are pre-built, niche-specific applications that sit on top of the LaunchKit core. Every template includes:

- Full LaunchKit core (auth, billing, database, email, AI)
- Niche-specific UI, copy, and flows
- A **Prompt Guide** — milestone-by-milestone AI prompts to build it using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Antigravity

<Note>
  Templates are available with the **Pro plan** ($299). The free template includes the base LaunchKit codebase.
</Note>

## Prompt Guides

Each template ships with a **Prompt Guide** — a structured set of AI prompts organized by milestone that tells you exactly how to build and customize the template using your AI coding agent.

The prompts specify:
- Which tool to use (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, etc.)
- Exactly what to ask for at each step
- Image generation prompts using [Higgsfield AI](https://higgsfield.ai)

Access prompt guides at [getlaunchkit.app/prompts](https://getlaunchkit.app/prompts).

## Using a Template

```bash
# Clone the pro repo (requires purchase)
git clone https://github.com/People-In-Tech/launchkit-pro.git my-project

# Navigate to template
cd my-project/templates/haveno

# Install and configure
pnpm install
cp .env.example .env.local
pnpm db:push
pnpm dev
```
